move: pie wedge sweeps to 68%, second wedge follows, badge pops, all collapses
how: A dark stage with a 340px SVG pie (a 140px-wide stroked circle so the dasharray reads as a solid wedge) and a savings legend. The pie scales in from .7 with back.out(1.6), the text staggers up. From 9% the green wedge sweeps to 68% (proxy tween, expo.out, 1.5s) while the centre tag counts and pops from .8 to 1.08 with back.out(3); at 50% a blue wedge extends to 100% with power3.inOut, updating the dollar figures. At 74% the pie bumps 1.04 and settles elastic while a Goal reached badge pops with back.out(2.2). From 90% the pie shrinks to .7 and fades (power3.in), text lifts out, and set() calls at the last frame reset every value.
adapt: Change the goal name, total (4800), the two wedge fractions, colours and the badge text; keep the 1.5s expo.out sweep and the 0.74D badge beat.
port: mount(el, shot) builds the pie SVG and legend from shot; animate returns the timeline with sweeps at 0.09D and 0.5D, badge at 0.74D, exit at 0.9D and the reset set() at D-0.001. Scope draw() querySelectors to el.
caveats: from() tweens need immediateRender:false in a composed timeline
